title: channels__recv — input
description: Input schema for the channels__recv MCP tool. The tool is non-blocking: it returns immediately with whatever messages have accumulated since the last drain. Defined in CONTRACTS.md §5.2.

channels.description: Optional list of channel names to drain. When null (or omitted), all channels the calling agent is subscribed to are drained.

max_messages.description: Maximum number of messages to return in a single call. Oldest messages (by sent_at, per-channel) are returned first up to this limit.
